name: mind-bridge
description: 小学心理咨询预约平台 - Mind Bridge

scripts.dev: npm run dev:db && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
